_what: Phase 0 of the overnight runbook — the A9 re-siting. J1 is saturated: its clean baseline is ~80% on stance d (RB2), leaving a 20-point ceiling no feasible N resolves. Before the C-BLOCK placebo (plan §8.7 step 4b) can be authored, the flagship probe needs a gate whose baseline mode sits 40–60%. This suite MEASURES that at J3. It is baseline-only by design: no live arm, no placebo, no mechanism claim. A rejected gate is still a finding (runbook §4 Phase 0 step 5).

authoring_choices: TIMELINE_EXCERPT is composed from J3's recent_events + present, plus ONE factual orienting line ('09:40 회선 A로 붕괴 예고 전화가 한 통 걸려 왔다…'). J3 is a mid-scenario gate and the slice's own recent_events assume the reader knows a call happened; without the line '역추적 1차 결과' is unmoored. The line is identical in structure across all three Phase-0 candidates so the three distributions stay comparable.

A8 scrub — the target axis of the block this program intends to inject is 공포/감정 판독 (K1's exception clause). The slice's present entry for 황보람 reads '출력물을 쥔 손에 힘이 들어가 있다', which is an implicit tension/fear cue. It is REMOVED and replaced with the axis-neutral '통신 담당. 출력물을 손에 들고 있다.' No 겁/무서움/떨림/숨소리 vocabulary appears anywhere in the frozen slots.
Threat-axis vocabulary (협박) is also avoided in the orienting line. It is a different axis (law #1's counter-example pair) and leaking it would confound a later fear-axis probe.
Stance labels are taken from J3's options verbatim — they are already behavior orientations with no quoted speech, so no rewrite was needed (plan §1).
PRIORITY_LIST and FLAW/INCIDENT are byte-identical to RB1/RB2 so the Phase-0 candidates differ from the established J1 measurement only in the gate.
_authoring_provenance.reachability_audit: P0-gate-siting.reachability.md — covers all three Phase-0 candidates

pre_registration.hypothesis: At gate J3 under K1 on template v0.4, with no block injected, the stance distribution is dispersed rather than saturated. This run measures that distribution in order to site the flagship C-BLOCK probe; per A1 it asserts no default stance, and per A9 the quantity that matters is the modal stance's share.
pre_registration.drop_condition: If the modal stance takes MORE than 6 of the kept calls (>60%), J3 is saturated in the sense A9 names and is REJECTED as the flagship site — do not raise N here. If the modal stance takes FEWER than 4 of the kept calls (<40%), the distribution is too dispersed for a shift to be resolvable at feasible N, and J3 is likewise rejected. Only a modal share of 40–60% accepts the gate. Rejection is a finding about the gate, not about any mechanism.
contingencies: If the discard rate exceeds RB2's baseline 17% materially, the residual malformation of A7/RB2 has worsened at a new gate — record it and note that arm-comparability (plan §8.5 step 4) is at risk for any probe sited here.
Fabricated because_block_ids are EXPECTED in a no-block arm and are a compliance number, not a discard and not a traceability failure (A5).
If every candidate gate lands outside 40–60%, the runbook's hard stop applies: stop and write the report rather than proceeding with a saturated or dispersed gate.
pre_registration.not_claimed: No live arm and no placebo arm. This measures a baseline distribution to choose a probe site. It credits nothing, tests no mechanism, and licenses no boundary law. The channel is declared SHAPE because nothing varies across arms — there is only one arm.
